name: rote
description: New to rote? /rote:setup walks you through importing your MCP servers, compiling one of your skills, and checking it gives the same answer. Compile an AI agent skill into a deterministic workflow for DBOS, Temporal, Cloudflare Workflows, Inngest, or plain Python with /rote:compile, fill in its emitted stub modules with /rote:implement, then trigger the deployed workflows from Claude over MCP with /rote:serve.
